reviews.text:
A positive experience. My Pepe stayed at the Via Pusiano facility for over a month, and I received videos every day.
I'm happy I chose Harmonia.
The grooming service was also excellent.
Well done everyone!!! I highly recommend it!
The staff is super friendly, helpful and you can tell that the dog is pampered and treated very well.
Always very good, my dog ​​is super happy

We had a great time; we finally found a place to leave our Chihuahua in case we need to go somewhere she can't come. We've never left her alone since she arrived (she was 6 years old). At the time, I was annoyed by having to introduce her like a baby, but in reality, it's helped her a lot, and in the videos they send out daily, you can see that she's gained a lot of confidence and is very open with people and other dogs. We'll definitely be back. They're a bit strict about the hours.
We've already sent Creamy to Harmonia Dog several times, always as a kennel. She has fun, plays, and is happy to see the place again. All the staff are kind and helpful.

They were simply perfect! Daily videos of my dog's activities, both in groups and individually! It was practically a 5-star vacation! I also found my dog ​​much more mature and more willing to listen, thanks to the people who supported her!

Harmonia Bocconi boarding house was fantastic for our big dog. The daily videos we received during our stay, describing her activities at the facility, entertained and reassured us, giving us peace of mind knowing she was in good hands. The staff was kind, helpful, and competent. The facility was clean and welcoming. We will definitely be returning for our beloved Mina's next vacation. Thanks again to the entire Harmonia team!

I loved this facility from the first moment, and I highly recommend it to anyone who needs to be away for a few days. They took such loving care of my puppy and always let me know how she was doing. I received daily videos of the playtime and training activities being performed. My dog ​​had a wonderful time, and I will definitely bring her back if needed.

Our dog stayed for 10 days during our vacation and was treated very well.
They sent us a video every evening for us to watch!
The staff is passionate about their work, and you can tell.
Highly recommended.

For me, leaving my beloved furry friend at Harmonia Bocconi is a real feeling of security! They make me feel at ease when I'm away, they take care of me, and they always organize individual activities as well as group ones!

I've known Harmonia for a few months. This was our first experience with a dog, and we initially turned to them for a point of reference, a safe place to leave him if needed. For three months now, Hagrid has been staying with them one day a week, and each time he leaves, he feels more relaxed and confident. He's a small dog, and at Harmonia he's learned to relate to dogs of all sizes and breeds; from the videos we watch at the end of the day, it's clear that he's having fun and feels safe.

Right from the first meeting to get to know our puppy and assess him, we realized we were dealing with highly trained people who are passionate about their work. We left that hour with lots of helpful advice that we immediately put into practice, so much so that we decided to take a dog training course with them as well. We're now one lesson away from finishing the course, and both we and Hagrid have learned so much. Yes, because it's not about learning simple commands that the dog must obey; They teach you to understand your dog's needs, to read his behaviors, and to correct our mistakes in our relationship with him. But above all, they teach you that this relationship and these behaviors will always evolve and that we will never stop learning.
I'm sure that, even after the course is over, they will always be ready to give us advice, with the same great availability they have always shown us.

August 25, 2026
After several years (day boarding, hotel, and grooming), I can only confirm the professionalism and care that the entire Harmonia staff always devotes to us and our two dogs.
They are a fundamental resource for us.

We needed to use their hotel and daycare service, and I must say it was a very positive experience. Receiving daily videos and updates about your furry friend is priceless. The dogs are cared for and pampered. The grooming service is also excellent. Thanks to all the staff, especially Giulia, with whom we started the journey.

Pepe "the Beagle" is thrilled to be going to Harmonia, calm and happy, and so are we. The "aunts" are all great and professional. TOP. My only small suggestion, if I may, is to improve the Pusiano location with renovations.
The staff were truly friendly and professional. Our dog was clean and smelled better than ever. We'll definitely be back when he needs a new grooming session.

This is our Coraline's third stay at Harmonia. Despite her being a dog with a few ailments, she shows no signs of discomfort either when we drop her off or pick her up. And she always follows our instructions to the letter. Thanks to all the Harmonia staff, and especially from us two-legged friends. Tiziana

Excellent experience for our Nilo. Extremely qualified staff. Every afternoon during our stay, they always sent us videos to share Nilo's day. I would say 5 stars are not enough. Thank you for everything. We are now loyal customers. We intend to use both the guesthouse and the daycare again.
Maria

This is the third time I've taken my two dogs to boarding, and I've always had a great experience, thanks in part to the videos they send out punctually every day. This year, they've also offered a pet driver service, which makes managing the care of my two dogs even easier.

This isn't just a daycare center and dog boarding facility. It's a place where dogs are loved, respected, and cared for with professionalism and expertise. When we left our golden retriever for eight days, we also took advantage of the grooming service. Bucky was treated with love and extreme professionalism by the groomer. A wonderful job, she gave us a beautiful dog, smelling great, and with a soft coat. The video of his grooming, sent to us via WhatsApp, showed our Bucky calm and at ease. It was more of a moment of pampering than "maintenance." For him, it was the first time ever.
Having a place where you can leave your dog without worries or concerns is a great thing.

I left my golden retriever in a hotel for 2 weeks. The sweet trainers took impeccable care of her, as always. I received more videos every day of her playing and doing her activities, like swimming or mind-activating games. They promptly contacted me about dermatitis caused by humidity (her weak point!) and immediately resolved the situation. I picked her up yesterday, happy, serene, clean, and smelling good. A huge thank you.
My Lola had a great time! And most importantly, she learned to swim! 😍 Super smart people, and we receive videos every day! Harmonia is the place we'll choose again if we ever need it! ♥️🐶♥️

Really Great place. The trainers took great care of my 7 month old puppy who stayed for 10 days . The boarding service is amazing and the socialization time too ( although a little crowded on some days ) . But over all I felt very relaxed and confident to leave my dog in Harmonia ! And he got a swimming class a a private training / play session as well as a groomer session. KiKo will be back soon . Thank you so much !!

Highly recommended. The staff is kind and professional, and they know how to treat fur based on the breed.
The grooming area is large and well-maintained!

This is the third long weekend that I've entrusted my English bulldog Obelix to this super five-star hotel—or rather, five-legged! Since I've brought him to Harmonia, the dog has completely changed. He's more sociable, less alone, and plays more even at home. I'm so happy to have met you and I recommend it to everyone. Oh, I almost forgot, I've already booked Obelix's holidays this summer at the Bocconi hotel. 🐶❤️
I'm thrilled with the results of my poodle's grooming at Harmonia! Perfect grooming and cutting, and most importantly, no stress for the puppy! I definitely recommend Claudia!

I was looking for a reliable and safe place to leave my miniature poodle for 15 days. Thanks to a friend's recommendation, I discovered Harmonia. The place is beautiful, clean, and welcoming, and the staff is very knowledgeable. After a three-day introduction, at the end of which Lana was deemed suitable (and I was able to check on her well-being and get to know the hotel better), I booked for the length of time I needed.
Everything was perfect: information, videos of Lana sent daily, and the staff were extremely kind. I also decided to have her groomed during her stay, and the groomer also proved to be very knowledgeable and kind. I picked Lana up after 15 days, looking great and beautiful.
Thank you, Harmonia, you're a great help 🐾

Highly recommended! I've been taking my two dogs for a few years now and have found them to be knowledgeable, kind, and caring. They take care of my furry friends while I'm away and keep me updated with videos and photos. After several less-than-positive experiences, I've finally found the perfect place. Thank you!!

Harmonia was my first experience at a dog daycare for my dachshund, Enzo, and I was thrilled from the start. The girls are fantastic, like real aunts to Enzo. They send me videos and photos of the various activities they take him on, and they manage to make the dogs feel at ease in a safe environment, always under their supervision. Thank you for everything.
Clean and well-maintained facility, professional and qualified staff. Our Labrador and Maltese thank you for the excellent treatment!! 🐕‍🦺🐩 …
We left our dog Iskra with us for a week. We're very happy with our choice; our expectations were fully met. Lella & Fulvio

Yes, they took impeccable care of my little Holly. From the videos, I could see how happy he was to share this experience with other dogs and how full of positive stimulation it was for him. A truly five-star vacation. I recommend it to everyone. He came home clean, groomed, and with so many positive experiences.

Mina is so happy after the sweet, professional, and talented Sofia freed her from knots, transforming her from wild to princess! BRAVA, BRAVISSIMA, you've been named our little lagotto's official dog stylist. Enzo

Harmonia Milano was a truly excellent choice for Milo's grooming 🐶
Impeccable service: great attention, care, and gentleness in treating the dogs. Milo was treated with patience and professionalism, and you can see that those who work there have a true passion for animals.
The end result was perfect: clean, fragrant, and cared for down to the smallest details. But the most important thing is the calmness with which it was handled, making him feel at ease throughout the entire treatment.
A reliable place, highly recommended for anyone who wants the best for their dog ✂️🐾

My two dogs always arrive at Harmonia happy because they know they'll find tons of human attention and lots of canine fun. I always recommend it to everyone because the level of professionalism is excellent.
My place to be! Harmonia is my lifeline every time I have to go on a trip! A beautiful, clean, and well-equipped facility, with highly professional educators.
It was the first time I left my puppy at Harmonia and everything went great!
Nino is having a great time and enjoying himself. When we take him out, he wags his tail like crazy. This is a constant occurrence.
I recommend it, clean, professional environment, calm and happy dogs when they return home
Highly recommended

After the placement process, I entrusted my two dogs to the shelter for two weeks during the summer.
It was the first time we'd both stayed outside of familiar surroundings.
The experience was extremely positive.
The shelter is very clean, bright, and designed with guests in mind.
The day alternates between group play, individual play, and rest.
Every evening, two videos are sent to you, allowing you to check your pet's mood.
The staff is kind, attentive, and seemed very in tune with the guests, who were also treated with affection.
We will certainly use this opportunity again if needed.

I'm writing this review because I wanted to thank Sofia for the love and passion she puts into her work! I've been grooming my two dogs (a poodle and a hamstaff) at this center for a while now, and I really enjoy her...always smiling, super kind, and professional!
The poodle's haircut is always perfect!
Highly recommended!
Filippo loves his nursery and his teachers! :-)
Absolutely the best! We have complete trust in the facility and the people who care for our friends with such passion and love. Whether it's for a few hours or a few days. Well done!
We were very happy to have Ted cared for by Harmonia Lambrate! Everything went well, and Ted seemed calm and at ease. The daily video updates were much appreciated!
My 7 month old Cane Corso have a very nice stay for 8 days.. it seems when he comes home he really miss the Harmonia hotel..5⭐️ for me and highly recommended for others💯💯💯 …

Cesare & Blu❤️💙
We took our two Golden Retrievers, Cesare & Blu, to daycare/boarding this summer.
We were very anxious because, as the years go by, our bond with our furry friends grows, and consequently, so does separation anxiety...
They understood our fears and reassured us by sending us extra videos, dedicated to their activities. So I could see them, and knowing them, I knew they were fine...
The Harmonia staff was very sensitive to our fears.
We thank all the staff for taking care of our loves ❤️💙Thank you

A wonderful experience at the Harmonia facility. Clark, our 1-year-old Doberman, stayed for 7 days and came back tired but happy! The staff were incredibly knowledgeable and always reassured us during these days of separation, and their daily video feed allowed us to see him play carefree, which helped us humans feel carefree too! The facility has just the right amount of space, and the staff are helpful and kind! Highly recommended! We WILL, of course, BE BACK!
Sofia's grooming of my poodle, Frizzy, is fantastic. A competition cut, and no stress. I'm really happy. Well done, Sofia! 👏 …
The best! 😁 …

I had booked a daycare assessment and emailed all the information because my Stella is quite old, 16 and a half. The gentleman who called me was super professional and polite. He explained to me that Stella is quite old, and that she obviously has different needs than other dogs and can't guarantee adequate care for Stellona. I received an immediate refund, and he was sincerely sorry he couldn't help me. He directed me to an in-home dog sitter, so Stella can stay in her own environment without being disturbed by other dogs; she sleeps a lot, and perhaps in a daycare there are also barking puppies that could interrupt her naps (as is only right). So, what can I say? She deserves the 5 stars for her honesty and professionalism. Thanks again!

While abroad for a nine-day trip, I tried this experience again. I can confirm that receiving daily videos of recreational activities, both outdoors and in the gym, with trainers, is very reassuring, especially since I know my dog ​​and can tell if she's having fun or not. Upon returning, I didn't find her behavior changed at all, unlike what had happened on another occasion at another center. On the last day of my stay, I also took advantage of the grooming service... The video showing the moment of relaxation was perfect. Congratulations to all the staff at the center. We'll definitely see each other again on our next trip, where Coby can't come with me.

This is the second time I've had to leave my dog ​​for an unexpected trip; for the second time, I can only thank the staff for their kindness and care.
I left her at the Via Pusiano location for 3-4 years; this time at Via Feraboli 60, so my review is completely valid!
For me, there's no better place to leave her.
I've been taking my bulldog to them for years. She's super calm, and they're very attentive. I highly recommend them!

When your dogs are happy to be somewhere even when you're not with them, that place becomes your constant companion. When you're away from your dogs and receive videos showing how happy they are even when you're not with them, you're not only at peace but also happy for them! Priceless!

It was the first time we left our furry friend at a boarding facility, and we were incredibly satisfied with the service we received. The love and attention they gave him was unparalleled, allowing us to enjoy our vacation abroad with complete peace of mind. We also decided to take advantage of the grooming service and were incredibly pleased with the results. Paddy was covered in knots, and the girls did an impeccable job! We later decided to enroll Paddington in daycare, a choice we'll make a thousand times over, as every time we drop him off and pick him up, our furry friend is so happy!
Thank you so much to the Harmonia Dog staff for everything ❤️
Super ❤️
As always, I repeat that I've always been very happy with the groomer and the facility in general, so I bring him here for both daycare and grooming. Catia

Good morning, even if the facility is not very new... my Fiona, a Golden, has been attending the nursery for a few months and today I can tell you that "his" dog sitters are fantastic... Mr. Alessandro is very kind and available for any need... I am having a great time... Fiona had her first heat and has never stopped attending the nursery... everyone is very attentive and she hasn't had any problems... even the birthday party for her first year was great fun. Recommended to my friends... Believe me, I recommend it....... Thank you, Thank you, I love you ❤️

Attentive service, friendly staff. I had a great experience with my rather fearful dog. I found her calm, clean, and smelling nice with a beautiful red bow. One thing to note, honestly, is that the final price was lower than the estimate because they hadn't found the knots they were expecting. I'll definitely be back.

Our experience at Harmonia has been completely positive. Our short-toed dog, Benji, a Maremma sheepdog, has had a great time, overcoming his initial shyness when playing with other dogs thanks to the group play sessions supervised by the truly skilled and knowledgeable staff. The facility is very easy to reach, even by subway, and offers large indoor and outdoor spaces where dogs can rest in peace and feel at home. The time the staff dedicate to individual play is very helpful and fun, with the aim of encouraging the dog to search for treats through exercises that stimulate the senses and instincts of our four-legged friends. The hours are convenient for daycare. We haven't tried boarding yet because we haven't needed it, but if we ever do, we will definitely turn to Harmonia. And as soon as we need another daycare session, our Benji will be thrilled to return!
I'm very happy with both the daycare and the boarding house! The staff and service are fantastic.

It was certainly a great experience for our Harvie (a 10-month-old Dachshund), who was somewhat fearful and solitary. After the welcome phase and a subsequent five-day stay, he definitely changed his attitude and happily stayed overnight during the short stays—Christmas Eve and Boxing Day—integrating with the small group of furry friends at the facility. Thanks to the staff who, even during the holidays, cared for and pampered our dog and the other dogs during these special days.
We are very satisfied with the service.
I've been using the daycare and hotel for my dog ​​for years, and I'm very happy with them. Now that I've tried the grooming service, I can say it's excellent!

I could say banal yet true things like: competent, kind, and helpful staff, but the most true thing is that my Jack Russell lives his life as a puppy at the daycare center, the educators respect his breed characteristics, and at the end of the day you can see how satisfied he is. Thanks guys, you're fantastic.
Well done, my super calm and shining Feather…

I've always bathed my cat periodically, especially during periods of hair loss. Unfortunately, even though she's been used to it since she was a kitten, she's always been a bit scared of bath time.
The experience at Harmonia Spa, however, was beautiful and relaxing; she didn't scratch, and I didn't need a cage... in fact... I had to wake her up :D
Another thing I noticed was that her fur remained beautiful and shiny for about two months (usually after a week, it's not that shiny anymore).
I found the online booking process very convenient, as well as the ability to select different treatment combinations and see available times.
I'm looking forward to seeing you again on Saturday!

We've been using the daycare for our little poodle for a few months now. The entire team is always kind, helpful, and welcoming, and the activities are always interesting! The groomers are also extremely helpful and patient. Cuts and washes are provided as requested!
All professional and competent people. Mine goes very happily.

Our Golden Retriever had the opportunity to grow up with Harmonia, having attended daycare one day a week for his entire first year. I'd let him write a review, since who knows the facility better than he does? Unfortunately, since my paws are too big for a computer keyboard, I'll have to do that myself, but I'll tell you about the feelings my big dog gives me.
Every time he realizes he's arrived at Harmonia, he can't wait to come in, meet his friends again, and spend a day running and playing.
The instructors are friendly and always available, as evidenced by the videos they send at the end of the day, summarizing the activities completed during their stay at the daycare/hotel. The dogs are often involved in individual training activities. The staff has always been helpful and easily reachable via WhatsApp for any request. A huge thank you to Harmonia for taking such good care of our big dog!
Everything was great, as always. Excellent communication with the staff, who sent a video of the day's activities via WhatsApp every evening.
A second home for Lucky

Always excellent. Simba only stayed one night, and Harmonia is always a safe bet, and I'll definitely book again for future vacations. The end-of-day video service is fantastic. Well done, guys, keep it up.
The facility is clean and well-organized, and the educators who pampered our little girl were expert and patient.
Perfect place for my furry friend! Fantastic staff, highly recommended.
As always, very good and very good!
We got along well, I immediately understood that I was dealing with competent people.

My Shitzu had a great time. She no longer shivers when I take her for a bath. The staff is incredibly empathetic with animals and provides personalized care. If you're looking for a different bathing experience for your dog, I highly recommend Harmonia.

I brought my wire-haired dachshund Ugo for the first time. I'm very happy with the end result; he was very well-groomed. Congratulations on your warm welcome, your kindness, and your professionalism!!! We'll see you again soon.
